text:
Sam (Sales): Hey team — ACME asked for a compliance bundle for the POC. They need SOC 2 Type II evidence, system description, a pen-test attestation/letter, an infra diagram, and a short note on encryption/retention. Target delivery: next Tue (2026-04-01). Also asking if we can do a 1-month Dedicated trial and what the pricing delta looks like. Can we assemble a package and timeline?

Emily (SE): Thanks Sam. We can put together a "SOC2 + artifacts" package but a few things to flag: we can share our latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where appropriate), system description, control matrix export, and an attestation from our pentest vendor. We can't share raw vulnerability scan outputs or customer logs without approvals. @Laura can confirm.

Laura (Security): +1. We can provide: SOC 2 Type II report PDF, system description (SSP-lite), control mappings for relevant CCs, and a pentest attestation letter dated within the last 12 months. For the full pen-test report we need Legal approval and a signed NDA from ACME. If they only need an attestation letter (vendor confirms a test occurred and high-level findings), we can provide that quickly.

Vishal (Infra): I can export an architecture diagram and network flow documents and sanitize any internal hostnames/IPs. Will produce: "infra-arch-acme-POC.pdf" and "network-flows-acme-POC.pdf". ETA: EOD tomorrow if no blockers.

Emily (SE): To help assemble faster, here's the minimal file list I'm planning to deliver: 
```
- 2025_SOC2_TypeII_redwood.pdf
- redwood_system_description_acme.txt
- control_matrix_relevant_controls.xlsx
- pentest_attestation_vendor.pdf
- infra-arch-acme-POC.pdf
- network-flows-acme-POC.pdf
- encryption_and_retention_summary.txt
```
I'll drop these into the evidence bucket and share a secure link.

Sam (Sales): @Laura re: NDA — ACME says they can sign an NDA if needed but want to avoid delays. If we send the attestation + SOC2 + sanitized diagrams, would that be sufficient to proceed? They said procurement will sign after the POC but security gate needs the docs now.

Laura (Security): Attestation + SOC2 + sanitized diagrams + retention/encryption statement should be sufficient for an initial review. If procurement requests the full pentest report later, we'll route via Legal and require the NDA. For the encryption statement: we should include KMS usage, TLS in transit, at-rest AES-256, and key rotation cadence.

Vishal (Infra): Quick note on the infra doc: I'll include a short section on network segmentation and no-public-master-nodes, and call out that PII is not stored in the POC environment.

Emily (SE): I created a folder and uploaded initial drafts to the secure share: https://redwood-secure-share.example.com/drive/acme-poc-evidence (link requires SSO). I'll send access to ACME once we get the green light from Legal for any sensitive files.

sec-bot: Evidence request created: ID EVID-2026-0421-ACME by Sam (Sales). Reminder: include data handling statement for PII.

Sam (Sales): Awesome — can we also include a short note on Dedicated trial pricing? Customer asked approximate monthly commit and what's included for enterprise trial.

Emily (SE): For a 1-month Dedicated trial, ballpark numbers: $Xk/month for a small reserved pool (est based on 2x A100-equivalents), includes support and up to N tokens/day. I'll pull exact quote from Pricing and post it here by EOD.

Laura (Security): Also, we should include the contact for our compliance lead in case ACME's security team wants a quick call: compliance@redwood.example.com.

Sam (Sales): OK thanks all — plan: 
- Emily: deliver package link w/ files (tomorrow EOD)
- Vishal: sanitized infra + network docs (tomorrow EOD)
- Laura: confirm attestation copy + any required Legal flags (tomorrow)
- Emily: pricing quote for 1-month Dedicated trial (EOD)
I'll coordinate with ACME and request NDA if they ask for the full pentest report.

Emily (SE): Copy. Will ping here when files are ready. :thumbsup:

Vishal (Infra): On it.

Laura (Security): I'll prepare the attestation and loop Legal if necessary.

Sam (Sales): Thanks everyone — will update ACME and post any follow-ups here.

Emily (SE): FYI — sample text for the encryption/retention note if helpful: 
"All customer data in the POC environment is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Keys are managed via our KMS with quarterly rotation. Retention for POC data is 30 days by default unless otherwise requested; backups are retained for 90 days."

Sam (Sales): Perfect, will use that. Closing loop after we get the link. :sparkles:
